name: base14-substitute
description: The anchor document set in one of prawn's fourteen built-in fonts, which the renderer names in the PDF rather than embedding. The preview has nothing to read out of the file the export used - there is no such file - so it serves a committed stand-in from packages/asciidoc-pdf/assets/base14-fonts and the question is whether that stand-in sets the same text to the same widths on the same baselines. No other anchor's theme names a base-14 family, so the substitute branch of the font plan was reached by nothing in this suite before this fixture, and the stand-in's own vertical metrics differ from prawn's AFM line box by about half an em - which is why only a real render can answer it.
